tools.name: amenitiz_list_properties
tools.description: List the hotel properties this credential can read. Use this first to find property IDs. GET /inventory/properties.

tools.name: amenitiz_get_property
tools.description: Fetch one property by UUID. GET /inventory/properties/{uuid}.

tools.name: amenitiz_list_unit_groups
tools.description: List the unit groups (room types) of one property, optionally filtered by name. GET /inventory/unit-groups.

tools.name: amenitiz_get_unit_group
tools.description: Fetch one unit group by UUID. GET /inventory/unit-groups/{uuid}.

tools.name: amenitiz_list_units
tools.description: List the physical units inside one unit group. GET /inventory/units.

tools.name: amenitiz_get_unit
tools.description: Fetch one unit by UUID. GET /inventory/units/{uuid}.

tools.name: amenitiz_list_bookings
tools.description: List bookings for one property. Pass a reference, or at least one From date (created, arrival, departure or cancelled). Each date axis spans at most 90 days. GET /bookings/bookings.

tools.name: amenitiz_get_booking
tools.description: Fetch one booking by UUID. GET /bookings/bookings/{uuid}.

tools.name: amenitiz_get_reservation
tools.description: Fetch one reservation (a room stay inside a booking) by UUID. GET /bookings/reservations/{uuid}.

tools.name: amenitiz_list_booking_payments
tools.description: List the payments recorded against one booking. GET /bookings/bookings/{uuid}/payments.

tools.name: amenitiz_list_booking_charges
tools.description: List the charges on one booking. GET /bookings/bookings/{uuid}/charges.

tools.name: amenitiz_list_invoices
tools.description: List invoices for one property, filtered by created date or by booking reference or number. GET /finance/invoices.

tools.name: amenitiz_get_invoice
tools.description: Fetch one invoice by UUID. GET /finance/invoices/{uuid}.

tools.name: amenitiz_list_rate_plans
tools.description: List the rate plans of one property: the sellable price products. GET /rates/rate-plans.

tools.name: amenitiz_get_availability
tools.description: List how many units are open to sell, per unit group and date, over a date window. GET /ari/availability.
